title: Investigating Youth AI Auditing
findings: Youth leveraged their personal identity characteristics, including being 'Muslim', as a source of knowledge and domain expertise when creating prompts to audit AI systems for problematic behavior. The paper does not report specific outcomes for this particular audit.
